games.headline: AJ Dybantsa sharp in his home debut as the Wizards smother Charlotte 95-79
games.desc: — Trae Young had 21 points, nine assists and seven rebounds, AJ Dybantsa scored 17 points in his home debut, and the Washington Wizards routed the Charlotte Hornets 95-79 on Friday night.

games.headline: Pritchard nets 30, Celtics ease past turnover-prone Bulls 125-111 in NBA Cup action
games.desc: — Payton Pritchard scored 30 points, and the Boston Celtics raced past the Chicago Bulls 125-111 on Friday night in the NBA Cup opener for both teams.

games.headline: Pistons rout the winless Nets 110-94 in an NBA Cup opener
games.desc: — Cade Cunningham scored 20 points, Duncan Robinson added 17 and the Detroit Pistons routed the Brooklyn Nets 110-94 on Friday night in an NBA Cup opener.

games.headline: LeBron James scores 20 points to help 76ers beat champion Knicks for 2nd time this season, 98-93
games.desc: — LeBron James scored 20 points and hit the go-ahead fadeaway late, and Tyrese Maxey had 27 points to lead the Philadelphia 76ers to a 98-93 win over the New York Knicks in an NBA Cup group game on Friday night.

games.headline: Bane scores 28 points, Wagner adds 26 points and 11 assists as Magic beat Raptors 121-114
games.desc: — Desmond Bane scored a season-best 28 points, Franz Wagner set season highs with 26 points and 11 assists, and the Orlando Magic overcame Scottie Barnes’ first 40-point game to beat the Toronto Raptors 121-114 in NBA Cup play Friday night.

games.headline: Giannis has triple-double, Heat open NBA Cup play with 145-125 win over Pacers
games.desc: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 31 points and had his second triple-double of the season, Bam Adebayo added 27 points and the Miami Heat opened NBA Cup play by beating the short-handed Indiana Pacers 145-125 on Friday night.

games.headline: Irving scores 35 and Flagg adds 33 as Mavericks hand Rockets 1st loss of season 116-111
games.desc: — Kyrie Irving scored 35 points, Cooper Flagg added 33 and the Dallas Mavericks rallied for a 116-111 victory over Houston, handing the Rockets their first loss of the season in an NBA Cup opener Friday night.

games.headline: Timberwolves blow out Clippers 127-101 behind Ball's 24 points for 1st win without Edwards
games.desc: — LaMelo Ball had a season-high 24 points and Jaden McDaniels scored 23 as the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Los Angeles Clippers...

games.headline: Stephen Curry scores 31 points and outduels Luka Doncic as Warriors come back to beat Lakers 112-95
games.desc: — Stephen Curry had 31 points, six assists and four rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors erased an early 25-point deficit then ran away from Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers for a 112-95 win Friday night in an NBA Cup game.

games.headline: Murray scores 39 points, Braun adds 31 to lead Nuggets over the Suns 127-120 in NBA Cup
games.desc: — Jamal Murray scored 39 points, Christian Braun added 31 and the Denver Nuggets rode a hot-shooting night to beat the Phoenix Suns 127-120 in an NBA Cup group stage game Friday night.
